title: Duality for Stochastic Control with non-Markovian Random Coefficients
summary: We develop novel duality methods for stochastic optimal control problems under two sources of randomness and non-Markovian random coefficients adapted to just one of them. The Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation is a second-order backward stochastic partial differential equation. Our duality theory provides an alternative description of the random value function in terms of a suitable pathwise optimal control problem parameterized by the realizations of one of the Brownian motions.
